world.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: original premium fruit-confectionery slot game background, cinematic wide landscape about 2:1, 2048 pixels wide if possible.
Primary request: a lush magical fruit orchard merging with rolling candyland, an outdoor landscape DISTINCT from any bakery interior. Beautiful hand-painted dimensional landscape: rounded green orchard hills, winding pale cream sugar path, jewel-colored fruit trees, distant confectionery towers softened by mist, warm golden late-afternoon light. A delightful sophisticated illustrated world, not a flat candy gradient.
Composition: wide view at slightly elevated eye level. Keep central-left 70 percent calm and low contrast, with softly detailed dusky teal orchard meadow and rolling hills reserved for a rectangular reel overlay. Place the main lush fruit-and-candy grove on far right: a gracefully curling tree bearing rich purple grapes, luminous green apples and plum fruit, a large sculptural pink-and-cream spiral lollipop growing near its roots, a waterfall of soft cream over smooth chocolate-colored stones. Foreground at extreme left edge has a few low berry leaves and ripe blueberries, not blocking center. Warm sun grazes the rightmost tree and distant apricot-colored clouds. Center is real continuous scenery, no architectural arch or frame.
Style: premium hand-painted 2.5D volumetric game concept art, tactile fruit skins and waxy leaves, tiny sugar crystals only at detailed edges, soft atmospheric depth, gorgeous controlled highlights, lush emerald/teal greens, warm cream, vivid berry purple and raspberry pink accents with sunlight gold. Elegant painterly shapes, no thick outlines or plastic toy look. No character.
Constraints: completely original artwork. No text, letters, labels, logos, watermarks, UI, reels, grid, slot machine, central framing arch, no emoji or flat vector. Landscape environment only.

atlas.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: original transparent game sprite sheet, twelve SMALL isolated premium fruit-and-candy icons with LOTS OF EMPTY SPACE. 4:3 landscape canvas, ideally 2048x1536. EXACTLY 4 columns × 3 rows of equal square cells. Make every icon only 55% of its cell's longest dimension. This means large blank transparent gutters of nearly half a cell between icons; do NOT enlarge the icons to fill the sheet. Mathematical center locations: x12.5%,37.5%,62.5%,87.5%; y16.67%,50%,83.33%. Each icon entirely within its cell, no overlap, no grid drawn.
Primary request: beautiful hand-painted 2.5D original confectionery fruit symbols to match a lush magical orchard. Richly modeled ripe fruit, jewel-like candy, painterly realistic material depth, strong simplified readable silhouettes at 40px, coherent warm sunlight top-left. Saturated fruit colors with restrained cream/gold highlights; no thick outlines, flat vectors, emoji or cheap plastic.
Exact reading order:
Row1 col1: glossy ruby-red heart-shaped hard candy, plump rounded bevels, deep translucent cherry red.
Row1 col2: hanging bunch of richly purple grapes, one curled fresh green leaf and short brown stem, tightly clustered iconic shape.
Row1 col3: juicy triangular red watermelon wedge with dark seeds and thick green rind, front three-quarter view.
Row1 col4: one ripe deep-violet plum with a soft natural wax bloom, one small green leaf, short stem.
Row2 col1: one luminous crisp green apple, short brown stem and one green leaf.
Row2 col2: cluster of THREE plump blue blueberries, silver-blue wax bloom and tiny crown-shaped calyx, one small leaf.
Row2 col3: curved bunch of three ripe golden-yellow bananas, compact upward curve, no peel opened.
Row2 col4: pink raspberry hard candy in a glossy twisted wrapper, horizontal silhouette.
Row3 col1: icy-blue hard candy in a glossy twisted wrapper, horizontal silhouette.
Row3 col2: round pink, cream and yellow spiral lollipop on a short ivory stick with small purple bow, bold readable circular head.
Row3 col3: magical purple-and-gold round confectionery multiplier bomb, glossy violet sphere with short curved licorice fuse and tiny star-spark, a broad plain cream round inset in its center reserved for native number overlay, NO number.
Row3 col4: ornament of two bright red cherries with joined stems and one leaf, spare decorative icon.
Constraints: TRUE transparent alpha background and gutters, not black or white matte and not a checkerboard. Opaque naturally antialiased icon surfaces. No text, letters, numbers, labels, logos, watermark, environment, floor, large halos, cast shadows or gridlines. Exactly twelve separate original objects, no extras. Smaller icons with large transparent gaps are essential for safe cropping.
atlas.spacingEdit:
Use case: precise-object-edit. Change ONLY the scale and placement of the attached original fruit-and-candy sprite atlas. Preserve all twelve exact icon designs, colors, materials, reading order, 4:3 canvas and TRUE transparent alpha background.
MAKE EVERY ICON 65% OF ITS CURRENT width and height, preserving its aspect ratio. The current icons nearly fill each cell. The required output must show conspicuously BIG empty transparent gaps between all rows and columns. Do not add anything to fill the empty space. No icon or sparkle may cross its own imaginary cell boundary.
Place each smaller icon at the precise center of an equal 4-column by 3-row square grid. x centers=12.5%,37.5%,62.5%,87.5%; y centers=16.6667%,50%,83.3333%. All surfaces remain opaque, outside transparent. Keep the complete lollipop stick and complete bomb fuse/star-spark inside their respective cells, with at least 15% cell padding.
Order row1 heart/grapes/watermelon/plum; row2 apple/blueberries/bananas/pinkwrappedcandy; row3 bluewrappedcandy/lollipop/purple multiplier bomb/cherries. Bomb center stays blank without numbers. No lettering, gridlines, checkerboard, backgrounds or additional objects. The goal is safe sprite isolation with smaller icons and large clear gaps, same premium painted artwork.
